versions.changelog:
YunZhi GEO Assistant v1.0.0 – initial release

- Provides a complete GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) health check and optimization pipeline for websites.
- Supports per-dimension analysis: site crawl, entity/brand/product/service recognition, competitor & intent analysis, coverage/credibility checks, structured data, FAQ, citation/reference inspection, and GEO Score calculation.
- Auto-generates optimization plans and impact-tiered actionable suggestions; can output JSON-LD/FAQ/meta snippet code.
- Includes a zero-dependency Python script for crawling, analysis, plan generation, auto-optimization, and validation.
- Designed for structured audits and AI-oriented site optimization—not for SEO content writing or non-GEO tasks.
